men.name: Riviera Linen Shirt
men.description: Washed Italian linen, camp collar, mother-of-pearl buttons. Cut slightly wider through the chest for airflow, then tapered at the hem so it sits clean untucked.
men.care: Machine wash cold, hang dry. Iron while damp for a crisp finish.

men.name: Jaipur Linen Kurta
men.description: Hand-finished mandarin collar with a single-needle run stitch. The placket is reinforced with a hidden facing — so it keeps its shape after dozens of washes.
men.care: Hand wash or gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Air dry in shade.

men.name: Stone Bomber
men.description: Garment-dyed cotton twill with ribbed collar and cuffs. Two-way brass zip. Interior pocket lined in brushed cotton — your phone won't scratch.
men.care: Machine wash cold, inside out. Tumble dry low.

men.name: Breeze Crew Tee
men.description: Ring-spun Supima cotton, pre-shrunk and enzyme-washed for a broken-in feel from day one. The hem is rolled, not folded — so it drapes instead of bunching.
men.care: Machine wash warm. Tumble dry medium. Gets softer every wash.

men.name: Dune Slim Chino
men.description: Brushed cotton with 2% stretch. Flat front, no pleats. The inseam is felled — a technique that takes four times longer but means the seam lies completely flat against your leg.
men.care: Machine wash cold. Hang dry. Iron medium heat.

men.name: Harbour Henley
men.description: Slub-knit cotton with corozo-nut buttons (not plastic). The raglan sleeve seam runs diagonally from collar to underarm, giving a broader shoulder line.
men.care: Machine wash cold. Reshape while damp.

men.name: Unstructured Linen Blazer
men.description: No padding, no canvas, no fusing. The lapel rolls naturally because it's cut on the bias. Patch pockets are sewn with a pick stitch you can see if you look closely.
men.care: Dry clean recommended. Or hand wash cold, reshape, air dry.

men.name: Knit Polo
men.description: Fine-gauge cotton knit, not piqué — so it moves like a sweater, not a shirt. Three-button placket with self-fabric collar that won't curl after washing.
men.care: Machine wash cold. Lay flat to dry.

kids.name: Petal Cotton Frock
kids.description: Organic cotton with a generous hem allowance — so you can let it down as she grows. The neckline is finished with a bias binding, not a scratchy serge.
kids.care: Machine wash gentle. No bleach. Air dry.

kids.name: Cloud Hoodie
kids.description: French terry inside, smooth jersey outside. The hood lining is jersey (not fleece) so it doesn't overheat. YKK zip pulls large enough for small fingers.
kids.care: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low.

kids.name: Sky Shorts Set
kids.description: Coordinated tee and shorts in garment-dyed cotton. Elastic waist with an internal drawcord (not external — to meet safety standards). All seams are flat-felled.
kids.care: Machine wash warm. Tumble dry medium.

kids.name: Little Nawab Kurta Set
kids.description: Muslin kurta with matching churidar. The kurta has a concealed side slit for movement. All edges are hand-rolled — a technique usually reserved for much pricier garments.
kids.care: Hand wash cold. Air dry in shade. Iron while damp.

kids.name: Scout Dungaree
kids.description: Soft twill with adjustable straps and nickel-free hardware. Reinforced at the knees because that's where every pair of kids' trousers eventually gives out.
kids.care: Machine wash warm. Tumble dry medium.

kids.name: Lamb's Ear Cardigan
kids.description: Fine-knit cotton with shell buttons — light enough for summer evenings. The rib cuffs are tighter than the body so sleeves stay pushed up.
kids.care: Hand wash cold. Lay flat to dry. Do not wring.

kids.name: Mini Riviera Shirt
kids.description: The same linen as our men's Riviera, scaled down. Pre-washed so it's already soft. The buttons are stitched with a cross pattern — stronger and easier for small hands to grip.

kids.name: Oat Jogger Set
kids.description: Loopback terry sweatshirt and tapered joggers. The fleece interior is brushed just once (not twice) — warm but not bulky. Ribbed cuffs at ankles keep the silhouette clean.
kids.care: Machine wash cold, inside out. Tumble dry low.
